input.title: Harborview Credit Union — member portal check-in
input.summary: Elena Sokolova reported that the board approved the Member Portal Refresh budget. The group kept the scope as written and put the login redesign first. Other work was moved to phase two. The person who signs off on the final design was not named.
decisions: Keep the Member Portal Refresh scope as written.
Start with the login redesign; everything else waits for phase two.

actionItems.quote: I'll send the revised timeline to both of you by Friday.

actionItems.task: Send the twelve most common login support tickets
actionItems.quote: I'll get you the list of the twelve most common support tickets about logging in.
We might also want to look at the mobile app at some point.

openQuestions: Who signs off on the final design at Harborview?

followUp.subject: Member portal: next steps
followUp.body:
Hi Elena and Raj,

Thanks for the update on the budget. We agreed to keep the Member Portal Refresh scope as written and to start with the login redesign, with everything else in phase two.

I will send the revised timeline by Friday. Raj, the list of the most common login tickets will help us prioritise.

One open point: who signs off on the final design on your side?

Best,
Casey
